summary: Approval-based Datadog observability and security platform credits, not an external LLM API grant. Applicants must be Series A or earlier and referred by an official partner; current/prior Datadog customers and prior startup-credit recipients are excluded. Allocation is specified in the acceptance notice. Activate within 30 days; program ends at credit exhaustion, removal, or 12 months after activation. Three months of inactivity can cause removal. Credits exclude taxes, technical/premier support and professional services. Standard paid billing follows completion. No claim deadline stated; no application or redemption tested.
claim_steps: Obtain a referral from an official Datadog startup partner; direct un-referred applications are not eligible.
Confirm Series A or earlier status and no current/prior Datadog customer or startup-credit history.
Apply through https://www.datadoghq.com/partner/datadog-for-startups/#apply with a valid Datadog account.
If accepted, review your awarded allocation and activate it within 30 days.
Monitor usage and the 12-month validity period; standard billing follows program completion.
